title: Job
description: One booked or requested piece of work. ambiguousEventId links it to the contractor's Ambiguous calendar event. Status transitions are validated by the agent loop (a canceled job cannot go en_route). Defined by the data model in docs/API.md.

ambiguousEventId.description: null until book_job lands the event

eta.description: current ETA texted to the client, when set

remindedAt.description: when the contractor was reminded to head to this job; absence means not yet reminded

packet.description: paperwork bundle created at booking time; shape is models/job-packet.schema.json
